content_record.title: Mitochondria as Brain Aging Hubs: Beyond Neurons
content_record.editorial_body: A new review maps how mitochondrial dysfunction spreads across brain cell types, revealing intercellular transfer as a metabolic lifeline and targeting mitochondria as a therapeutic frontier. Three things to remember - Mitochondria integrate and amplify brain aging across neurons, glia, and vascular cells. - Intercellular mitochondrial transfer offers a novel metabolic rescue mechanism. - Clinical trials now test mitochondria-targeted interventions for cognitive decline. Source This signal is based on Mitochondria and brain aging: From cell-specific dysfunction to intercellular cooperation. from PubMed. Read the original report for full context. Health note: Review article; no quantitative data or trial outcomes provided.
